summary.question: Performance monitoring shows degraded signal quality on service svc207 (100GE between S12 and S18) from about t=660 s. What is the cause?

llm.report: The system concluded that the degradation was caused by the combined AMP_GAIN_TILT at oms.S18-S02.amp4 and WSS_ATTEN_DRIFT at oms.S12-S11|4, with probability 0.974. Coherent diagnostics on trx.och135.z showed estimated OSNR of 18.75 dB, pre-FEC BER of 0.00189804739570689, and margin of 3.11 dB. Swapping oms.S18-S02.amp6 left symptoms unchanged, while swapping oms.S18-S02.amp4 cleared them. The investigation required 5.52 hours and two site visits.

template: Cause: AMP_GAIN_TILT@el:oms.S18-S02.amp4()+WSS_ATTEN_DRIFT@el:oms.S12-S11|4() (probability 0.974).
